name: Sarah Reyes
title: Software Engineer II
background: Latina, first-gen college, grew up in South Seattle. Was working retail at 22 when she found Ada Build.
quote: I was exactly where you are. Ada changed everything — and it's genuinely free.

name: Marcus Johnson
title: Data Analyst
background: Black youth from Tacoma. No college degree. Year Up placed him at Amazon — he never left.
quote: You don't need a degree. You need the right program and someone who's been there.

name: Priya Nguyen
title: Product Manager
cohort: GEAR UP UW 2018, Ada Core Cohort 17
background: Vietnamese-Indian, first-gen college. GEAR UP sent her to UW campus for the first time at 16 — she never thought college was for her until that summer.
quote: GEAR UP showed me the door. Ada walked me through it.

name: Carlos Medina
title: Cloud Engineer
background: Mexican-American, dropped out of high school at 17. Got GED at 20. NPower gave him a shot when no one else would.
quote: A GED and willingness to work hard — that's all you need. The programs do the rest.

name: Jasmine Williams
title: UX Designer
background: Black, grew up in Renton. Found Hack the Hood through her school counselor. Built her first website at 17.
quote: I didn't know design was a tech career until Hack the Hood. Now I design products used by millions.
